quotes.quote: We publish two image generation benchmarks: AA-Image-T2I v2.1: models that generate an image from a text prompt only. AA-Image-Editing v2.1: models that modify a reference image based on a text prompt.
Public serverless endpoints only: benchmarking covers true serverless endpoints that are, or will be, publicly available.
For fair comparison across models, we apply the following normalizations: We generate at 1024×1024.
We generate 1 image per prompt. We use a 1:1 aspect ratio. We use a seed of 42.
Benchmarking is conducted with strict independence and objectivity. No compensation is received from any providers for listing or for favorable outcomes on Artificial Analysis.
At Artificial Analysis, we treat AA-Image-Editing v2.1 and Reference to Image as two independent benchmarks, based on where each capability sits in end-user workflows.
For AA-Image-Editing v2.1, we test a model's ability to make specific, localized changes to an image while keeping the rest of the image unchanged.
The rating is anchored on FLUX.2 [dev] = 1000 for the overall leaderboard and for all subcategory leaderboards.

We only include votes cast on the AA-Image-Editing v2 test set, between models that are part of AA-Image-Editing v2.1. When a model moves to a new arena host, votes on its earlier outputs stop counting.

Each model's Elo score reflects its relative quality, derived from blind votes cast by our validated private evaluators. We fit all votes at once with a Bradley-Terry model and report the result on an Elo scale.
Blind pairwise voting: Evaluators see two outputs generated from the same prompt by two different models, without model identities, and select the one they prefer.
Every item in our prompt set is a curated pair: a source image and an edit instruction written against it.
Our prompts are written to reflect how end users actually prompt, informed by anonymized crowdsourced data and a human-curated, live-updated prompt corpus.
Freshness: We refresh our prompt set every month, following the same methodology as AA-Image-T2I v2.1.
A monthly refresh cadence also protects the integrity of the leaderboard: a prompt set that rotates cannot be overfit.

The same ten use cases we measure for AA-Image-T2I v2.1: Marketing & Advertising, Retail & E-commerce, Live-Action Film, Animation & Gaming, Architecture & Real Estate, Productivity & Knowledge Work, UI/UX Design, Consumer, Social Media & Creator Content, and Frontier.

Object-Level Edit: Adding, removing, replacing, or altering specific objects in the frame…Scene & Style Edit: Relighting, restyling, and changes to the background, setting, or overall treatment…Enhancement & Restoration: Denoising, retouching, artifact removal, and repair of damaged or degraded images
Composition & Framing: Cropping, extending, reframing, and changes to camera view or perspective…Identity-Preserving Edit: Changes to people, faces, and characters that must keep identity intact
Text or Symbol Edits: Editing text, typography, logos, and symbols within the image…Reasoning-Based Edit: Edits requiring inference about the scene rather than a literal instruction

Statistical method: The Elo calculation, confidence intervals and Range column follow an updated, more rigorous statistical method. Confidence intervals now include the uncertainty in every other model's rating.
On the overall leaderboard, the Range column now comes from simulating the full leaderboard; filtered views and category leaderboards show the range implied by each model's confidence interval.
Confidence intervals treat each vote as independent, so they may be slightly narrow if votes from the same evaluator or prompt are correlated.
Prompts: AA-Image-Editing v2.1 uses the same prompt taxonomy and monthly refresh as v2.0.
Models that we no longer maintain, or that have too few votes to rank reliably, leave the leaderboard.
Each prompt is tagged with 1 use case and 1 primary capability tag.
We sample prompts evenly across each use case and capability combination.

Which is the best AI image editing model on AA-Image-Editing v2.1? GPT Image 2.6 Sunburst (max) currently leads AA-Image-Editing v2.1 with an Elo score of 1210.

Models are ranked using an Elo rating system derived from blind comparisons judged by our validated private evaluators. Voters compare edited outputs from the same input image and editing instruction, choosing the result they prefer. Higher Elo scores indicate a model is preferred more often.

Text to Image generation creates entirely new images from text descriptions, while image editing modifies existing images based on instructions. Image editing models take both an input image and editing instructions, then produce a modified version of the original image.
H3-Image currently leads among open weights models on AA-Image-Editing v2.1 with an Elo score of 1138, followed by Fibo 2.0 (Elo 1085) and Qwen-Image-2.1 (Elo 1084).
